title: UniGIO: Unified Generative Global In-situ Weather Modeling from Spatiotemporal Incomplete Observations
abstract: arXiv:2609.22217v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Global In-situ Observation (GIO) provides fine-scale, direct records of the global weather system from sparse point stations, making it an indispensable source for capturing localized and transient dynamics beyond the reach of satellite gridded data, and playing a critical role in key fields such as numerical weather prediction, disaster prevention, and agriculture. However, GIO exhibits strong spatiotemporal incompleteness, severely impairing accurate and real-time in-situ weather modeling. Unlike existing methods waiting for completed AI-ready data with extra introduced errors, in this work, we explore UniGIO, a novel generative framework for directly modeling global in-situ weather dynamics from native incomplete GIO. By generating missing data from observed ones annotated by masks, it unifies the coexisting forecasting, imputation, and generation under arbitrary missing ratios. translated_title: UniGIO：基于时空不完整观测的统一生成式全球原位天气建模
translated_abstract: 全球原位观测（GIO）通过稀疏的站点提供全球天气系统的精细尺度直接记录，是捕捉卫星网格数据无法触及的局部化与瞬态动态不可或缺的数据来源，并在数值天气预报、防灾减灾和农业等关键领域发挥着重要作用。然而，GIO表现出强烈的时空不完整性，严重影响了准确且实时的原位天气建模。与现有等待完整AI就绪数据（且引入额外误差）的方法不同，本工作提出了UniGIO，一种新颖的生成式框架，可直接从原生不完整的GIO数据建模全球原位天气动态。通过从以掩码标注的观测数据中生成缺失数据，它将共存的预测、插补和生成任务统一在任意缺失率之下。在缺失数据与观测数据之间，UniGIO捕获平稳（性）……
tldr: UniGIO提出了一种统一的生成式框架，可直接从时空不完整的全球原位观测数据建模天气动态，将预测、插补与生成任务统一在任意缺失率下，无需依赖引入额外误差的完整AI就绪数据。
en_tdlr: UniGIO is a unified generative framework that directly models global in-situ weather dynamics from native spatiotemporal incomplete observations, unifying forecasting, imputation, and generation under arbitrary missing ratios without relying on completed AI-ready data.
